tasks.label: skuzic: dev + magenta
tasks.detail: Runs the Vite dev server and the Magenta RT2 bridge together.

tasks.label: skuzic: magenta bridge
tasks.detail: Local MRT2 WebSocket bridge on ws://localhost:8765

tasks.label: skuzic: setup magenta
tasks.detail: One-time: create .venv, install magenta-rt, fetch weights. Idempotent.
tasks.command: [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q --upgrade pip uv && .venv/bin/uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python 'magenta-rt[mlx]' websockets numpy && .venv/bin/mrt models init && .venv/bin/mrt models download mrt2_base
